dafcom.utils.config module#

Configuration utilities for DAFCOM

This module provides utilities for loading and validating configuration files.

dafcom.utils.config.load_config(config_path: str | Path) → Dict[str, Any][source]#

Load a YAML configuration file.

Parameters:

config_path – Path to the YAML configuration file

Returns:

Dict containing the configuration parameters

Raises:

  • FileNotFoundError – If the configuration file doesn’t exist

  • ValueError – If the configuration file is invalid

dafcom.utils.config.validate_config(config: Dict[str, Any], required_keys: list) → bool[source]#

Validate that a configuration dictionary contains all required keys.

Parameters:

  • config – Configuration dictionary to validate

  • required_keys – List of required keys

Returns:

True if valid, False otherwise
